-- Hunting Helper: single-file build for Delta/local file or a raw HTTPS URL.
-- Generated by build-bundle.py. User settings remain local to each emulator.
-- Autoexecute can run before the game has finished replicating player data.
if not game:IsLoaded() then game.Loaded:Wait() end
if game.GameId ~= 10769401924 then return end
local players = game:GetService("Players")
local storage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local readyBy = os.clock() + 180
while true do
    local player = players.LocalPlayer
    local navReady, nav = pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(storage:GetAttribute("NavMapJson") or "") end)
    if player and tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Level")) and storage:FindFirstChild("Remotes")
        and storage:FindFirstChild("Shared") and navReady and type(nav)=="table" and type(nav.Zones)=="table" and next(nav.Zones) then break end
    if os.clock() > readyBy then warn("Hunting Helper: game data did not become ready; run the script again") return end
    task.wait(0.5)
end
local sources = {
    ["scp.lua"] = [====[-- Hunting Together: level-based travel, respawn return, Auto Gear/Card, gear sales.
-- Delta: loadstring(readfile("scp.lua"))()
-- Sells ONLY unequipped, unlocked weapons/armor. No potions, cards or materials.
local CONFIG = {
    SellAtPercent = 95,
    ReservedSlots = 2,
    MaxZoneOrder = 12,
    FarmRadius = 40,
    RespawnDelay = 3,
    DeathLimit = 3,
    DeathWindow = 180,
    DowngradeSeconds = 600,
    StartEnabled = true,
}

local env = getgenv and getgenv() or _G
if env.HuntingHelper and type(env.HuntingHelper.Destroy) == "function" then env.HuntingHelper:Destroy() end
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RS = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local Http = game:GetService("HttpService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer
assert(game.GameId == 10769401924, "This script is for Hunting Together only")
local remotes = RS:WaitForChild("Remotes", 15)
local shared = RS:WaitForChild("Shared", 15)
assert(remotes and shared, "Game data is not ready")
local MapData = require(shared:WaitForChild("MapData"))
local MonsterData = require(shared:WaitForChild("MonsterData"))
local ItemData = require(shared:WaitForChild("ItemData"))
local GearUtil = require(shared:WaitForChild("GearUtil"))

local function decode(text)
    if type(text) ~= "string" then return {} end
    local ok, data = pcall(Http.JSONDecode, Http, text)
    return ok and type(data) == "table" and data or {}
end
local function json(name) return decode(player:GetAttribute(name)) end
local state = {
    Active = false, Generation = 0, Destroyed = false, Zone = nil,
    Sold = 0, Status = "Ready", ForceSell = false, ForceEquip = false,
    Deaths = {}, DowngradeUntil = 0, History = {}, Connections = {},
}
env.HuntingHelper = state
local initialSettings = player:GetAttribute("BotJson")
local function character()
    local c = player.Character
    local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
    if c and h and r and h.Health > 0 then return c, h, r end
end
local function setAuto(on)
    if (player:GetAttribute("AutoOn") == true) ~= on then
        local event = player:FindFirstChild("LumiMenuToggle")
        if event and event:IsA("BindableEvent") then event:Fire("autoToggle") end
    end
end
local function saveStatus()
    if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
    pcall(function()
        local _, _, r = character()
        writefile("hunting-helper-status.json", Http:JSONEncode({
            Active = state.Active, Status = state.Status, Zone = state.Zone,
            Sold = state.Sold, Level = player:GetAttribute("Level"),
            BagUsed = player:GetAttribute("BagSlotsUsed"),
            BagMax = player:GetAttribute("BagSlotsMax"),
            Position = r and tostring(r.Position), History = state.History,
            Boss = state.BossActive and state.BossActive.Id, BossKills = state.BossKills,
            Dodges = state.Dodges, Options = state.Options, LastBossSkill = state.LastBossSkill,
            Looting = state.Looting, LootRemaining = state.LootRemaining,
            Team = state.Team, BoxStatus = state.BoxStatus, BoxPending = state.BoxPending,
            BoxEncounter = state.BoxEncounter, BoxesOpened = state.BoxesOpened, LuckyRemaining = state.LuckyRemaining,
            LastBoxTrigger = state.LastBoxTrigger, LastBoxNotice = state.LastBoxNotice,
            GameAutoSkill = player:GetAttribute("AutoSkill"), GameAutoSkillError = state.GameAutoSkillError,
            FarmSpot = state.FarmSpot,
            TravelWalk = state.TravelWalk,
        }))
    end)
end
local function status(message)
    if state.Status ~= message then
        state.Status = message
        table.insert(state.History, os.date("!%H:%M:%S", os.time()+7*3600) .. " " .. message)
        while #state.History > 60 do table.remove(state.History, 1) end
        print("[Hunting Helper] " .. message)
        saveStatus()
    end
end
local CANCELLED = "HUNTING_HELPER_STOPPED"
local function check(token)
    if state.Destroyed or not state.Active or state.Generation ~= token then error(CANCELLED, 0) end
end
local function sleep(seconds, token)
    local deadline = os.clock() + seconds
    repeat task.wait(math.min(0.2, math.max(0, deadline - os.clock()))); check(token) until os.clock() >= deadline
end
local function nav() return decode(RS:GetAttribute("NavMapJson")) end
local function pickZone(level)
    local options = {}
    local zones = nav().Zones or {}
    for id, data in pairs(MapData) do
        if type(data) == "table" and id:match("^Field%d+$") and not data.BossRoom and zones[id] then
            local minimum = tonumber((data.LevelText or ""):match("%d+"))
            if minimum and minimum <= level and (data.Order or 999) <= CONFIG.MaxZoneOrder then
                table.insert(options, {Id=id, Data=data, Minimum=minimum})
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(options, function(a, b)
        if a.Minimum == b.Minimum then return (a.Data.Order or 0) > (b.Data.Order or 0) end
        return a.Minimum < b.Minimum
    end)
    local index = #options
    if os.clock() < state.DowngradeUntil then index = math.max(1, index - 1) end
    return options[index]
end
local FarmPlan=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-farm-plan.lua")))()
local farmCachePath="hunting-helper-farm-spots-"..player.UserId..".json"
local farmCache={}
pcall(function()
    local saved=decode(readfile(farmCachePath))
    if saved.Version==1 and type(saved.Zones)=="table" then farmCache=saved.Zones end
end)
local aggro=tonumber(require(shared.GameConfig).LeaderAggroRange) or 37.5
local function farmPoint(zone,preview)
    local z = assert((nav().Zones or {})[zone.Id], "Zone coordinates missing")
    local cached=farmCache[zone.Id]
    if FarmPlan.Valid(z,cached,CONFIG.FarmRadius,aggro) then return cached end
    local allowed={}
    for _,spawn in ipairs(zone.Data.Spawns or {}) do allowed[spawn.Id]=true end
    local leader=FarmPlan.LeaderFallback(z)
    local observed=false
    local points={}
    for _,model in ipairs(game:GetService("CollectionService"):GetTagged("Monster")) do
        local root=model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart
        local definition=MonsterData[model:GetAttribute("MonsterId")]
        if root and definition and allowed[model:GetAttribute("MonsterId")]
            and math.abs(root.Position.X-z.X)<=z.SX/2 and math.abs(root.Position.Z-z.Z)<=z.SZ/2
            and (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0)>0
            and (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("ThreatUserId")) or 0)==0
            and (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0)>=(tonumber(model:GetAttribute("MaxHP")) or math.huge)*0.99 then
            if definition.Leader then
                -- A fighting leader may have been pulled away from its spawn corner.
                if root.Position.X>z.X+z.SX*0.25 then
                    leader={X=root.Position.X,Z=root.Position.Z}; observed=true
                end
            elseif not (definition.Boss or definition.MiniBoss or definition.Retired) then
                points[#points+1]={X=root.Position.X,Z=root.Position.Z}
            end
        end
    end
    local plan=FarmPlan.Choose(z,leader,points,CONFIG.FarmRadius,aggro)
    plan.Source=observed and "idle leader" or "estimated layout"
    plan.Zone=zone.Id
    if not preview then
        state.FarmSpot=plan
        -- Empty/unstreamed fields use a temporary landing point and are refined
        -- after arriving. Actual farm anchors stay fixed across boss/sale trips.
        local rightCount=0
        for _,point in ipairs(points) do if point.X>z.X then rightCount+=1 end end
        if rightCount>=3 and plan.Count>0 then
            farmCache[zone.Id]=plan
            pcall(function() writefile(farmCachePath,Http:JSONEncode({Version=1,Zones=farmCache})) end)
        end
    end
    return plan
end
local function positionForZone(zone)
    local z=(nav().Zones or {})[zone.Id]
    local plan=farmPoint(zone)
    state.FarmSpot=plan
    return Vector3.new(plan.X,z.Y+5,plan.Z)
end
local function inZone(root, zone)
    local z = (nav().Zones or {})[zone.Id]
    return z and math.abs(root.Position.X-z.X) <= (z.SX or 192)/2 + 6
        and math.abs(root.Position.Z-z.Z) <= (z.SZ or 166)/2 + 6
        and math.abs(root.Position.Y-z.Y) < 45
end
local walkBeforeWarp=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-travel-walk.lua")))()({
    State=state,Player=player,Character=character,Json=json,Nav=nav,Status=status,Sleep=sleep,Check=check,
})
local function moveTo(point, token)
    check(token)
    setAuto(false)
    sleep(0.35, token)
    local c, h, r = character()
    if not c then return false end
    h.Sit=false
    if not walkBeforeWarp(point,token) then return false end
    check(token)
    c,h,r=character()
    if not c then return false end
    h:Move(Vector3.zero, false)
    h.Sit = false
    c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(point))
    r.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    r.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
    sleep(1.5, token)
    local _, _, current = character()
    if not current then return false end
    local delta = current.Position-point
    assert(Vector2.new(delta.X, delta.Z).Magnitude <= 25 and math.abs(delta.Y) < 45,
        "Travel was rejected; paused")
    return true
end
local function prepareFarm(zone, token)
    local settings = json("BotJson")
    local only = {}
    local level = state.GetFarmLevel and state.GetFarmLevel() or tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Level")) or 1
    for _, spawn in ipairs(zone.Data.Spawns or {}) do
        local mob = MonsterData[spawn.Id]
        if mob and not (mob.Boss or mob.MiniBoss or mob.Leader or mob.Retired) and mob.Level <= level then
            only[spawn.Id] = true
        end
    end
    assert(next(only), "No suitable normal monsters in this zone")
    settings.Only = only
    settings.FixedArea = true
    settings.Range = CONFIG.FarmRadius
    settings.Radius = CONFIG.FarmRadius
    settings.SkipBoss = false
    settings.SkipLeader = false
    settings.AttackLeader = true
    settings.OpenBoxes = false
    settings.Mode = "fight"
    settings.Exclude = settings.Exclude or {}
    for id in pairs(only) do settings.Exclude[id] = nil end
    for _,spawn in ipairs(zone.Data.Spawns or {}) do settings.Exclude[spawn.Id]=nil end
    for id,mob in pairs(MonsterData) do
        if mob.Zone==zone.Data.Order and (mob.MiniBoss or mob.Leader) then settings.Exclude[id]=nil end
    end
    remotes.SetBotSettings:FireServer(settings)
    sleep(0.5, token)
    setAuto(true)
end
local function equipmentSnapshot()
    return tostring(player:GetAttribute("EquipJson")) .. "|" .. tostring(player:GetAttribute("WeaponId"))
        .. "|" .. tostring(player:GetAttribute("CardsJson"))
end
local function equipBest(token)
    status("Auto Gear, then Auto Card")
    check(token)
    remotes.EquipItem:FireServer("@best")
    sleep(1.5, token)
    remotes.CardAction:FireServer("auto")
    sleep(1.5, token)
    -- Wait for equipment replication to settle before deciding what is unused.
    local snapshot = equipmentSnapshot()
    for _ = 1, 12 do
        sleep(0.3, token)
        local current = equipmentSnapshot()
        if current == snapshot then return end
        snapshot = current
    end
    error("Equipment did not settle; nothing sold")
end
local function saleCandidates()
    local equipped, locked = {}, json("LocksJson")
    local weapon = player:GetAttribute("WeaponId")
    if type(weapon) == "string" then equipped[weapon] = 1 end
    for _, id in pairs(json("EquipJson")) do
        if type(id) == "string" then equipped[id] = (equipped[id] or 0) + 1 end
    end
    local list = {}
    local gears = json("GearJson")
    for id in pairs(gears) do
        if not equipped[id] and not locked[id] then
            local ok, item = pcall(GearUtil.Resolve, id, gears)
            if ok and item and (item.Kind == "weapon" or item.Kind == "armor") and (item.Sell or 0) > 0 then
                list[#list+1] = {id, 1}
            end
        end
    end
    for id, count in pairs(json("ItemsJson")) do
        local item = ItemData[id]
        if type(count) == "number" and type(item) == "table" and not locked[id]
            and (item.Kind == "weapon" or item.Kind == "armor") and (item.Sell or 0) > 0 then
            local amount = math.floor(count - (equipped[id] or 0))
            if amount > 0 then list[#list+1] = {id, amount} end
        end
    end
    table.sort(list, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
    return list
end
local function inventoryCount(id)
    if json("GearJson")[id] then return 1 end
    return tonumber(json("ItemsJson")[id]) or 0
end
local function sellEquipment(token)
    status("Returning to merchant")
    local merchant = (nav().Npcs or {}).merchant
    if not merchant then
        local model = workspace:FindFirstChild("Map")
        model = model and model:FindFirstChild("NPCs")
        model = model and model:FindFirstChild("merchant")
        assert(model, "Merchant not found")
        local point = model:GetPivot().Position
        merchant = {X=point.X, Y=point.Y, Z=point.Z}
    end
    local target = Vector3.new(merchant.X+5, merchant.Y+2, merchant.Z+3)
    if not moveTo(target, token) then return end
    local shop = player:FindFirstChild("HuntShop")
    if shop then shop:Fire("sell") end
    sleep(0.6, token)
    equipBest(token)
    local total = 0
    for _ = 1, 100 do
        check(token)
        if not character() then return end
        local list = saleCandidates() -- Always re-read locks and equipped items.
        if #list == 0 then break end
        local entry = list[1]
        local before = inventoryCount(entry[1])
        local silverBefore = player:GetAttribute("Silver")
        status("Selling unused gear: " .. entry[1])
        remotes.ShopSellMany:FireServer({entry})
        local sold = false
        for _ = 1, 25 do
            sleep(0.2, token)
            local now = inventoryCount(entry[1])
            if now < before then
                local amount = before-now
                state.Sold = state.Sold+amount
                total = total+amount
                table.insert(state.History, "Sold " .. entry[1] .. " x" .. amount
                    .. " | Gold " .. tostring(silverBefore) .. " -> " .. tostring(player:GetAttribute("Silver")))
                sold = true
                break
            end
        end
        assert(sold, "Sale was not confirmed; paused without retrying")
    end
    status("Sale complete: " .. total .. " equipment items")
    -- Close the shop opened by this routine.
    local event = player:FindFirstChild("HuntShop")
    if event then event:Fire("close") end
    state.Zone = nil
    local used = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("BagSlotsUsed")) or 0
    local maximum = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("BagSlotsMax")) or 120
    assert(used < maximum - CONFIG.ReservedSlots and used/maximum*100 < CONFIG.SellAtPercent,
        "Bag still full of protected or non-equipment items; paused")
end
local function death(token)
    setAuto(false)
    status("Waiting for town respawn")
    state.Deaths[#state.Deaths+1] = os.clock()
    local recent = 0
    for _, at in ipairs(state.Deaths) do if os.clock()-at <= CONFIG.DeathWindow then recent = recent+1 end end
    if recent >= CONFIG.DeathLimit then
        state.DowngradeUntil = os.clock()+CONFIG.DowngradeSeconds
        state.Deaths = {}
        status("Repeated deaths: using an easier zone for 10 minutes")
    end
    local nextChoice = 0
    while not character() or player:GetAttribute("HuntRespawnWaiting") == true do
        check(token)
        if os.clock() >= nextChoice then
            remotes.RespawnChoice:FireServer("town")
            nextChoice = os.clock()+6
        end
        sleep(0.5, token)
    end
    sleep(CONFIG.RespawnDelay, token)
    state.Zone = nil
end

local ui
local function run(token)
    while state.Active and state.Generation == token do
        check(token)
        if not character() or player:GetAttribute("HuntRespawnWaiting") == true then death(token) end
        if state.GetTeamPlan and not state.GetTeamPlan().Ready then
            setAuto(false)
            status("Waiting for all party member levels")
            sleep(1,token)
            continue
        end
        local used = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("BagSlotsUsed")) or 0
        local maximum = tonumber(player:GetAttribute("BagSlotsMax")) or 120
        if state.ForceSell or used >= maximum-CONFIG.ReservedSlots or used/maximum*100 >= CONFIG.SellAtPercent then
            state.ForceSell = false
            sellEquipment(token)
        end
        if state.ForceEquip then state.ForceEquip = false; equipBest(token) end
        if state.ForceCollect and state.CollectBossLoot then
            local room=state.ForceCollect
            state.ForceCollect=nil
            state.CollectBossLoot(room,nil,token)
            state.Zone=nil
        end
        if state.PartyFollow and state.PartyFollow(token) then saveStatus(); sleep(0.5,token); continue end
        if state.BossController then state.BossController(token) end
        local farmLevel=state.GetFarmLevel and state.GetFarmLevel() or tonumber(player:GetAttribute("Level")) or 1
        local zone = assert(pickZone(farmLevel), "No suitable zone found")
        local _, _, root = character()
        if root and (state.Zone ~= zone.Id or not inZone(root, zone)) then
            status("Traveling to " .. zone.Data.DisplayName)
            if moveTo(positionForZone(zone), token) then
                local refined=positionForZone(zone)
                local _,_,arrived=character()
                if arrived and (Vector2.new(arrived.Position.X-refined.X,arrived.Position.Z-refined.Z)).Magnitude>3 then
                    if not moveTo(refined,token) then continue end
                end
                prepareFarm(zone, token)
                state.Zone = zone.Id
                status("Farming: " .. zone.Data.DisplayName .. " | " .. zone.Data.LevelText)
            end
        elseif root and player:GetAttribute("AutoOn") ~= true then
            setAuto(true)
        end
        if state.BoxController then state.BoxController(token) end
        saveStatus()
        sleep(1, token)
    end
end
function state:Stop(internal)
    self.Active = false
    self.Generation = self.Generation+1
    setAuto(false)
    self.ForceSell = false
    self.ForceEquip = false
    self.LootTarget = nil
    self.Looting = false
    if self.BoxCancel then self.BoxCancel() end
    if self.CancelTravelWalk then self.CancelTravelWalk() end
    if not internal and self.SetOption then self:SetOption("LastRunning",false) end
    if self.UI then self.UI:Refresh() end
    status("Paused")
    saveStatus()
end
function state:Start()
    if self.Active or self.Destroyed then return end
    self.Active = true
    self.Generation = self.Generation+1
    self.Zone = nil
    local token = self.Generation
    if self.SetOption then self:SetOption("LastRunning",true) end
    if self.UI then self.UI:Refresh() end
    task.spawn(function()
        local ok, err = pcall(run, token)
        if not ok and not tostring(err):find(CANCELLED, 1, true) and self.Generation == token then
            self:Stop(true)
            status("Paused: " .. tostring(err):sub(-160))
            warn(err)
        end
    end)
end
function state:Destroy()
    self:Stop(true)
    self.Destroyed = true
    if self.CleanupExtra then self.CleanupExtra() end
    for _, connection in ipairs(self.Connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
    if initialSettings then pcall(function() remotes.SetBotSettings:FireServer(decode(initialSettings)) end) end
    if self.UI then self.UI:Destroy() end
    if env.HuntingHelper == self then env.HuntingHelper = nil end
end
function state:RequestSell() self.ForceSell = true; if not self.Active then self:Start() end end
-- Read-only helpers used to verify the current plan without sending any remotes.
state.PreviewSales = saleCandidates
state.PreviewZone = function(level) local zone=pickZone(level); return zone and zone.Id end
state.PreviewFarmSpot=function(id)
    return farmPoint({Id=id,Data=assert(MapData[id],"Unknown field")},true)
end
local extraChunk, extraError = loadstring(readfile("hunting-extra.lua"))
assert(extraChunk, extraError)
extraChunk()({
    State=state, Player=player, Remotes=remotes, Http=Http, Monsters=MonsterData,
    Character=character, SetAuto=setAuto, Nav=nav, Json=json, Status=status,
    MoveTo=moveTo, Sleep=sleep, Check=check, Config=CONFIG,
    SellEquipment=sellEquipment, Decode=decode,
})
ui=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-ui.lua")))()(state,player)
state.UI=ui
if CONFIG.StartEnabled and state.Options.ResumeOnLoad and state.Options.LastRunning then state:Start() end
]====],
    ["hunting-extra.lua"] = [====[return function(ctx)
    local s,p,r = ctx.State,ctx.Player,ctx.Remotes
    local RS=game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    local Run=game:GetService("RunService")
    local G=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-geometry.lua")))()
    local collectLoot=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-loot.lua")))()(ctx)
    G.SelfTest()
    local config=require(RS.Shared.GameConfig)
    local monsters=ctx.Monsters
    local BossPlan=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-boss-plan.lua")))()
    local bosses=BossPlan.Build(require(RS.Shared.MapData),monsters)
    local Settings=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-settings.lua")))()
    local options,saveSettings,settingsPath,readSettings=Settings.Open(p.UserId,ctx.Http)
    local casts,blocked={},{}
    local heartbeatAt=0
    local function applyConfig()
        ctx.Config.FarmRadius=options.FarmRadius
        ctx.Config.SellAtPercent=options.SellAtPercent
    end
    local function persist()
        local ok=saveSettings(options)
        s.SettingsSaved=ok
        s.SettingsPath=settingsPath
        applyConfig()
    end
    local statNames={"STR","AGI","VIT","INT","DEX","LUK"}
    local function readOptions()
        local data=readSettings()
        if type(data)~="table" then return end
        for key,value in pairs(Settings.Normalize(data)) do options[key]=value end
        applyConfig()
    end
    readOptions()
    s.Options=options
    s.BossKills=0
    s.Dodges=0
    s.BossActive=nil
    s.DodgeUntil=0
    s.BossGeometry=G
    s.BossPlan=BossPlan
    s.BossCatalog=bosses
    local function alive(id)
        local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Monsters")
        for _,model in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if model:IsA("Model") and model:GetAttribute("MonsterId")==id and (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0)>0 then return model end
        end
    end
    local function readiness(boss)
        local definition=monsters[boss.Id]
        local level=s.GetFarmLevel and s.GetFarmLevel() or tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Level")) or 1
        local healer=false
        if s.GetTeamPlan then
            for _,member in ipairs(s.GetTeamPlan().Members) do if member.Job=="Cleric" then healer=true end end
        end
        return BossPlan.Readiness(boss,definition,{Level=level,MaxHP=tonumber(p:GetAttribute("MaxHP")) or 0,
            DEF=tonumber(p:GetAttribute("DEF")) or 0,MDEF=tonumber(p:GetAttribute("MDEF")) or 0,
            HasHealer=healer},config.MaxBaseLevel or 99)
    end
    local function bossAvailable(boss)
        if not options[boss.Option] or not readiness(boss) then return false end
        if (blocked[boss.Id] or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return false end
        return workspace:GetAttribute("BossAlive_"..boss.Id)==true or alive(boss.Id)~=nil
    end
    local function nextSpawn(id)
        local interval=monsters[id].ClockRespawn or 600
        local now=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
        return now+interval-(math.floor(now)%interval)+3
    end
    table.insert(s.Connections,r.BossFx.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(action,bossName,skillName,shapes,duration)
        if not s.Active or not s.BossActive or type(shapes)~="table" then return end
        local key=tostring(bossName).."|"..tostring(skillName)
        if action=="cancel" then casts[key]=nil
        elseif action=="warn" then
            local residual=0
            for _,shape in ipairs(shapes) do residual=math.max(residual,G.Residual(shape)) end
            casts[key]={Shapes=shapes,Expires=os.clock()+math.max(0,tonumber(duration) or 0)+residual+0.45,Name=tostring(skillName)}
            s.LastBossSkill=tostring(skillName)
        elseif action=="hit" then
            if casts[key] then casts[key].Expires=math.max(casts[key].Expires,os.clock()+0.35) end
            local persistent,residual={},0
            for _,shape in ipairs(shapes) do
                local lifetime=G.Residual(shape)
                if lifetime>0 then persistent[#persistent+1]=shape; residual=math.max(residual,lifetime) end
            end
            if #persistent>0 then casts[key.."|residual"]={Shapes=persistent,Expires=os.clock()+residual+0.45,Name=tostring(skillName)} end
        end
    end))
    table.insert(s.Connections,Run.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if s.Destroyed or not s.Active or not s.BossActive or not options.Dodge or os.clock()<heartbeatAt then return end
        heartbeatAt=os.clock()+0.06
        for key,cast in pairs(casts) do if os.clock()>cast.Expires then casts[key]=nil end end
        local c,h,root=ctx.Character()
        if not root then return end
        local activeZone=(ctx.Nav().Zones or {})[s.BossActive.Room]
        if activeZone and (math.abs(root.Position.X-activeZone.X)>activeZone.SX/2+15
            or math.abs(root.Position.Z-activeZone.Z)>activeZone.SZ/2+15
            or math.abs(root.Position.Y-activeZone.Y)>45) then return end
        if next(casts) and not G.Safe(root.Position,casts,3) then
            local zone=(ctx.Nav().Zones or {})[s.BossActive.Room]
            local safe=G.FindSafe(root.Position,casts,zone,3.5)
            if safe then
                s.DodgeFailure=nil
                ctx.SetAuto(false)
                h:Move(Vector3.zero,false)
                c:PivotTo(CFrame.new(safe))
                root.AssemblyLinearVelocity=Vector3.zero
                s.Dodges=s.Dodges+1
                ctx.Status("Dodge: "..tostring(s.LastBossSkill or "boss skill"))
            else
                ctx.SetAuto(false)
                s.DodgeFailure=true
                ctx.Status("No safe point found for boss warning")
            end
            local untilTime=os.clock()+0.1
            for _,cast in pairs(casts) do untilTime=math.max(untilTime,cast.Expires) end
            s.DodgeUntil=untilTime
        end
        if os.clock()<s.DodgeUntil then h:Move(Vector3.zero,false) end
    end))
    local function targetBoss(model)
        local target=p:FindFirstChild("CurrentTarget")
        if target and target:IsA("ObjectValue") and target.Value~=model then target.Value=model end
    end
    local function fight(boss,token)
        local definition=monsters[boss.Id]
        local zone=(ctx.Nav().Zones or {})[boss.Room]
        if not zone then return end
        ctx.Status("Boss: "..definition.Name)
        s.BossActive=boss
        s.DodgeFailure=nil
        table.clear(casts)
        local finished,err=pcall(function()
            if not ctx.MoveTo(Vector3.new(zone.X+24,zone.Y+5,zone.Z+12),token) then return end
            local model
            for _=1,20 do
                model=alive(boss.Id)
                if model then break end
                if workspace:GetAttribute("BossAlive_"..boss.Id)==false then break end
                ctx.Sleep(0.25,token)
            end
            if not model then blocked[boss.Id]=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+30; return end
            local settings=ctx.Json("BotJson")
            settings.FixedArea=false
            settings.AttackLeader=true
            settings.SkipBoss=false
            settings.SkipLeader=false
            settings.Only={[boss.Id]=true}
            settings.Exclude={}
            settings.Radius=85
            settings.Range=85
            settings.Mode="fight"
            r.SetBotSettings:FireServer(settings)
            ctx.Sleep(0.4,token)
            ctx.SetAuto(true)
            targetBoss(model)
            local started=os.clock()
            local lastBossPosition=model:GetPivot().Position
            local lastHP=tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HP")) or definition.HP
            local damageAt=started
            while options.Bosses and options[boss.Option] and os.clock()-started<(boss.Timeout or 240) do
                ctx.Check(token)
                if s.GetFarmLevel and s.GetFarmLevel()<BossPlan.RequiredLevel(definition,config.MaxBaseLevel or 99) then
                    ctx.Status("Party minimum level changed; leaving boss room")
                    return
                end
                if s.DodgeFailure then
                    blocked[boss.Id]=nextSpawn(boss.Id)
                    ctx.Status("Retreat: no safe point for boss skill")
                    return
                end
                local _,h,root=ctx.Character()
                if not root then blocked[boss.Id]=nextSpawn(boss.Id); return end
                local hp=tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0
                if hp>0 and model.Parent and model.PrimaryPart then lastBossPosition=model:GetPivot().Position end
                if hp<=0 or not model.Parent or workspace:GetAttribute("BossAlive_"..boss.Id)==false then
                    s.BossKills=s.BossKills+1
                    blocked[boss.Id]=nextSpawn(boss.Id)
                    ctx.Status("Defeated "..definition.Name.."; collecting loot")
                    local hazardEnd=os.clock()
                    for _,cast in pairs(casts) do
                        for _,shape in ipairs(cast.Shapes) do
                            if G.Residual(shape)>0 then hazardEnd=math.max(hazardEnd,cast.Expires) end
                        end
                    end
                    local waitUntil=math.min(hazardEnd,os.clock()+8)
                    while os.clock()<waitUntil and ctx.Character() do
                        ctx.SetAuto(false)
                        ctx.Status("Waiting for lava/spin to finish before collecting loot")
                        ctx.Sleep(0.15,token)
                    end
                    collectLoot(boss.Room,lastBossPosition,token)
                    return
                end
                if hp<lastHP then damageAt=os.clock(); lastHP=hp end
                if h.Health/h.MaxHealth<0.22 then
                    blocked[boss.Id]=nextSpawn(boss.Id)
                    ctx.Status("Retreat: low HP against "..definition.Name)
                    return
                end
                if os.clock()-damageAt>25 then
                    blocked[boss.Id]=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+90
                    ctx.Status("Boss not taking damage; returning to farming")
                    return
                end
                if os.clock()>=s.DodgeUntil then
                    ctx.SetAuto(true)
                    targetBoss(model)
                    ctx.Status("Boss: "..definition.Name.." | HP "..math.floor(hp))
                else
                    ctx.SetAuto(false)
                    h:Move(Vector3.zero,false)
                end
                if (tonumber(p:GetAttribute("BagSlotsUsed")) or 0)>=(tonumber(p:GetAttribute("BagSlotsMax")) or 120)-2 then return end
                ctx.Sleep(0.15,token)
            end
            blocked[boss.Id]=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+90
        end)
        s.BossActive=nil
        s.DodgeUntil=0
        s.DodgeFailure=nil
        table.clear(casts)
        s.Zone=nil
        ctx.SetAuto(false)
        if not finished then error(err,0) end
    end
    s.BossController=function(token)
        if not options.Bosses then return end
        if s.ShouldHuntBoss and not s.ShouldHuntBoss() then return end
        for _,boss in ipairs(bosses) do
            if bossAvailable(boss) then fight(boss,token); return end
        end
    end
    local pendingStatAt=0
    local pendingStatValue=nil
    local pendingStatName=nil
    local requestedManualAt=nil
    local attemptedBoost={}
    task.spawn(function()
        local refreshAt=0
        while not s.Destroyed do
            if os.clock()>refreshAt then readOptions(); refreshAt=os.clock()+2 end
            if s.Active and ctx.Character() then
                if options.AutoStats then
                    if (p:GetAttribute("AutoBuild") or "manual")~="manual" then
                        if not requestedManualAt then
                            requestedManualAt=os.clock()
                            r.SetAutoBuild:FireServer("manual")
                        elseif os.clock()-requestedManualAt>5 then
                            options.AutoStats=false; persist()
                            ctx.Status("Custom stats paused: Manual build was not confirmed")
                        end
                    elseif pendingStatValue then
                        requestedManualAt=nil
                        local current=tonumber(p:GetAttribute(pendingStatName)) or 0
                        if current>pendingStatValue then pendingStatValue=nil
                        elseif os.clock()-pendingStatAt>4 then
                            pendingStatValue=nil; options.AutoStats=false; persist()
                            ctx.Status("Stat allocation not confirmed; auto stats paused")
                        end
                    elseif (tonumber(p:GetAttribute("StatPoints")) or 0)>0 then
                        requestedManualAt=nil
                        local current=tonumber(p:GetAttribute(options.Primary)) or 0
                        if current<(config.MaxStat or 99) then
                            pendingStatName,pendingStatValue,pendingStatAt=options.Primary,current,os.clock()
                            r.AllocateStat:FireServer(options.Primary)
                        end
                    end
                else pendingStatValue=nil end
                if options.AutoBoost then
                    for _,boost in ipairs({{Id="drop_potion",Key="Drop"},{Id="exp_potion",Key="Exp"}}) do
                        local untilTime=tonumber(p:GetAttribute("Boost"..boost.Key.."Until"))
                        local active=false
                        for _,buff in pairs(ctx.Json("BuffsJson")) do
                            local id=tostring(buff.Id or ""):lower()
                            if id:find(boost.Key:lower(),1,true) and (tonumber(buff.EndsAt) or 0)>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then active=true end
                        end
                        local count=tonumber(ctx.Json("ItemsJson")[boost.Id]) or 0
                        if not active and (not untilTime or untilTime<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()) and count>0 and not attemptedBoost[boost.Id] then
                            attemptedBoost[boost.Id]=true -- Never repeatedly consume on an unknown buff response.
                            r.UseItem:FireServer(boost.Id)
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
            task.wait(0.8)
        end
    end)
    function s:SetOption(key,value)
        if Settings.Defaults[key]==nil then return end
        local input=table.clone(options)
        input[key]=value
        local normalized=Settings.Normalize(input)
        options[key]=normalized[key]
        if key=="FarmRadius" then s.Zone=nil end
        if key=="AutoStats" then
            requestedManualAt=nil
            if options.AutoStats and (p:GetAttribute("AutoBuild") or "manual")~="manual" then
                requestedManualAt=os.clock(); r.SetAutoBuild:FireServer("manual")
            end
        end
        if key=="AutoBoost" then attemptedBoost={} end
        persist()
    end
    s.SaveSettings=persist
    persist()
    s.PreviewBosses=function()
        local result={}
        for _,boss in ipairs(bosses) do
            local ready,reason,minimum,neededHP=readiness(boss)
            result[#result+1]={Name=monsters[boss.Id].Name,Room=boss.Room,Enabled=options[boss.Option],
                Ready=ready,Reason=reason,RequiredLevel=minimum,RequiredHP=neededHP,Available=bossAvailable(boss),NextSpawn=nextSpawn(boss.Id)}
        end
        return result
    end
    local skillPending=nil
    s.SetGameAutoSkill=function(_,on)
        if skillPending or type(on)~="boolean" then return end
        options.RestoreGameSkill=true
        options.GameAutoSkill=on
        persist()
        skillPending={Expected=on,At=os.clock()}
        s.GameAutoSkillPending=true
        s.GameAutoSkillError=nil
        r.SetAutoSkill:FireServer(on)
    end
    task.spawn(function()
        local restored=false
        while not s.Destroyed do
            if skillPending then
                if (p:GetAttribute("AutoSkill")~=false)==skillPending.Expected then skillPending=nil; s.GameAutoSkillPending=false
                elseif os.clock()-skillPending.At>5 then skillPending=nil; s.GameAutoSkillPending=false; s.GameAutoSkillError="Auto Skill not confirmed" end
            end
            if not restored and s.Active then
                restored=true
                if options.RestoreGameSkill and (p:GetAttribute("AutoSkill")~=false)~=options.GameAutoSkill then s:SetGameAutoSkill(options.GameAutoSkill) end
            end
            task.wait(0.4)
        end
    end)
    assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-team-box.lua")))()(ctx,options,persist)
end
]====],
    ["hunting-geometry.lua"] = [====[-- Geometry from the BossFx warning payload, in the horizontal plane.
local G = {}
local function flat(v) return Vector3.new(v.X, 0, v.Z) end
function G.Center(shape)
    if (shape.Fx=="spin" or shape.Kind=="spin") and typeof(shape.Model)=="Instance" and shape.Model.Parent then
        return shape.Model:GetPivot().Position
    end
    return shape.Center
end
function G.Residual(shape)
    return math.max(0,tonumber(shape.PoolTime) or 0,
        (shape.Fx=="spin" or shape.Kind=="spin") and (tonumber(shape.Duration) or 5) or 0)
end
function G.Inside(p, shape, margin)
    margin = margin or 0
    if shape.Kind == "circle" or shape.Kind=="donut" or shape.Kind=="spin" or shape.Safe then
        local center=G.Center(shape)
        if typeof(center) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        local distance=(flat(p)-flat(center)).Magnitude
        local inner=tonumber(shape.Inner or shape.InnerRadius) or 0
        return distance<=math.max(0,(shape.Radius or 0)+margin)
            and (inner<=0 or distance>=math.max(0,inner-margin))
    elseif shape.Kind == "cone" then
        if typeof(shape.Center) ~= "Vector3" or typeof(shape.Dir) ~= "Vector3" then return false end
        local d, direction = flat(p-shape.Center), flat(shape.Dir)
        if d.Magnitude > (shape.Radius or 0)+margin then return false end
        if d.Magnitude < 0.001 then return true end
        if direction.Magnitude < 0.001 then return false end
        local angle = math.acos(math.clamp(d.Unit:Dot(direction.Unit), -1, 1))
        return angle <= (shape.Half or 0)+math.atan(math.max(margin, 0)/math.max(d.Magnitude, 1))
    elseif typeof(shape.CFrame) == "CFrame" then
        local q = shape.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(p)
        return math.abs(q.X) <= (shape.Width or 0)/2+margin and math.abs(q.Z) <= (shape.Length or 0)/2+margin
    end
    return false
end
function G.Safe(p, casts, margin)
    for _, cast in pairs(casts) do
        local room, green = false, false
        for _, shape in ipairs(cast.Shapes) do
            if shape.Room and G.Inside(p, shape, 0) then room = true end
            if shape.Safe and G.Inside(p, shape, -(margin or 0)) then green = true end
        end
        if room and not green then return false end
        for _, shape in ipairs(cast.Shapes) do
            if not shape.Room and not shape.Safe and G.Inside(p, shape, margin or 0) then return false end
        end
    end
    return true
end
function G.FindSafe(current, casts, zone, margin)
    local candidates = {current}
    local function add(x, z) candidates[#candidates+1] = Vector3.new(x, current.Y, z) end
    for _, cast in pairs(casts) do
        for _, shape in ipairs(cast.Shapes) do
            local center=G.Center(shape)
            if typeof(center)=="Vector3" and (shape.Safe or shape.Kind=="donut" or (tonumber(shape.Inner or shape.InnerRadius) or 0)>0) then add(center.X,center.Z) end
        end
    end
    for _, distance in ipairs({5, 10, 15, 22, 30, 42, 55, 75, 100, 130}) do
        for i=0,31 do
            local angle = i*math.pi/16
            add(current.X+math.cos(angle)*distance, current.Z+math.sin(angle)*distance)
        end
    end
    if zone then
        for ix=-4,4 do
            for iz=-4,4 do add(zone.X+ix*((zone.SX or 70)/2-4)/4, zone.Z+iz*((zone.SZ or 50)/2-4)/4) end
        end
    end
    local best, score
    for _, p in ipairs(candidates) do
        local inside = not zone or (math.abs(p.X-zone.X) <= (zone.SX or 70)/2-3 and math.abs(p.Z-zone.Z) <= (zone.SZ or 50)/2-3)
        if inside and G.Safe(p, casts, margin) then
            local cost = (flat(p-current)).Magnitude
            if not score or cost < score then best, score = p, cost end
        end
    end
    return best
end
function G.SelfTest()
    local circle={Kind="circle",Center=Vector3.zero,Radius=8}
    assert(G.Inside(Vector3.new(7,0,0),circle,0))
    assert(not G.Inside(Vector3.new(10,0,0),circle,0))
    local box={Kind="line",CFrame=CFrame.new(),Width=12,Length=70}
    assert(G.Inside(Vector3.new(5,0,20),box,0))
    assert(not G.Inside(Vector3.new(10,0,20),box,0))
    local cone={Kind="cone",Center=Vector3.zero,Dir=Vector3.new(0,0,-1),Radius=34,Half=math.rad(50)}
    assert(G.Inside(Vector3.new(0,0,-20),cone,0))
    assert(not G.Inside(Vector3.new(0,0,20),cone,0))
    local cast={Shapes={{Room=true,CFrame=CFrame.new(),Width=70,Length=50},{Safe=true,Center=Vector3.new(15,0,0),Radius=9}}}
    assert(not G.Safe(Vector3.zero,{cast},2))
    assert(G.Safe(Vector3.new(15,0,0),{cast},2))
    local escape=G.FindSafe(Vector3.zero,{{Shapes={circle}}},{X=0,Z=0,SX=70,SZ=50},3)
    assert(escape and G.Safe(escape,{{Shapes={circle}}},3))
    local green=G.FindSafe(Vector3.zero,{cast},{X=0,Z=0,SX=70,SZ=50},3)
    assert(green and G.Safe(green,{cast},3))
    local ring={Kind="circle",Center=Vector3.zero,Radius=60,Inner=16}
    assert(not G.Inside(Vector3.zero,ring,3))
    assert(G.Inside(Vector3.new(20,0,0),ring,3))
    assert(not G.Inside(Vector3.new(70,0,0),ring,3))
    local inner=G.FindSafe(Vector3.new(20,0,0),{{Shapes={ring}}},{X=0,Z=0,SX=70,SZ=50},3)
    assert(inner and not G.Inside(inner,ring,3))
    assert(G.Residual({PoolTime=3})==3)
    assert(G.Residual({Fx="spin",Duration=5})==5)
    local cross={Shapes={{CFrame=CFrame.new(),Width=12,Length=70},{CFrame=CFrame.Angles(0,math.pi/2,0),Width=12,Length=70}}}
    local crossSafe=G.FindSafe(Vector3.zero,{cross},{X=0,Z=0,SX=70,SZ=50},3)
    assert(crossSafe and G.Safe(crossSafe,{cross},3))
    return 17
end
return G
]====],
    ["hunting-loot.lua"] = [====[return function(ctx)
    local s,p=ctx.State,ctx.Player
    local tags=game:GetService("CollectionService")
    local run=game:GetService("RunService")
    local binding="HuntingHelperLootMove_"..p.UserId
    run:UnbindFromRenderStep(binding)
    run:BindToRenderStep(binding,Enum.RenderPriority.Character.Value+20,function()
        if not s.Active or not s.LootTarget then return end
        local _,h,root=ctx.Character()
        if not root then return end
        local delta=s.LootTarget-root.Position
        local direction=Vector3.new(delta.X,0,delta.Z)
        h:Move(direction.Magnitude>2 and direction.Unit or Vector3.zero,false)
    end)
    s.CleanupExtra=function()
        s.LootTarget=nil
        run:UnbindFromRenderStep(binding)
    end
    local function eligible(drop,zone,anchor,ownOnly)
        if not drop:IsA("BasePart") or not drop.Parent or tags:HasTag(drop,"LootBox") then return false end
        local owner=tonumber(drop:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")) or 0
        if ownOnly and owner~=p.UserId then return false end
        local freeAt=tonumber(drop:GetAttribute("FreeAt")) or 0
        if owner~=0 and owner~=p.UserId and freeAt>workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then return false end
        local point=drop.Position
        return math.abs(point.X-zone.X)<=(zone.SX or 70)/2+18
            and math.abs(point.Z-zone.Z)<=(zone.SZ or 50)/2+18
            and math.abs(point.Y-zone.Y)<35
            and (Vector3.new(point.X,0,point.Z)-Vector3.new(anchor.X,0,anchor.Z)).Magnitude<50
    end
    local function sweep(room,anchor,token)
        local zone=assert((ctx.Nav().Zones or {})[room],"Loot zone not found")
        local _,_,root=ctx.Character()
        if not root then return end
        anchor=anchor or root.Position
        local ownOnly=room:match("^Field")~=nil
        local observed={}
        local started=os.clock()
        local observeUntil=started+4
        local quietAt=nil
        local target,progressAt,lastDistance,pickupAt=nil,started,math.huge,0
        s.Looting=true
        s.LootRemaining=0
        s.BossActive=nil
        s.DodgeUntil=0
        ctx.SetAuto(false)
        local ok,err=pcall(function()
            while os.clock()-started<45 do
                ctx.Check(token)
                local _,h,current=ctx.Character()
                if not current then return end
                for _,drop in ipairs(tags:GetTagged("Drop")) do
                    if eligible(drop,zone,anchor,ownOnly) then observed[drop]=true end
                end
                local list={}
                for drop in pairs(observed) do
                    if drop.Parent and eligible(drop,zone,anchor,ownOnly) then list[#list+1]=drop else observed[drop]=nil end
                end
                table.sort(list,function(a,b) return (a.Position-current.Position).Magnitude<(b.Position-current.Position).Magnitude end)
                s.LootRemaining=#list
                if #list==0 then
                    s.LootTarget=nil
                    h:Move(Vector3.zero,false)
                    if os.clock()>observeUntil then
                        quietAt=quietAt or os.clock()
                        if os.clock()-quietAt>=2 then ctx.Status("Boss loot collected; area checked clear"); return end
                    end
                    ctx.Status("Checking for remaining boss drops")
                else
                    quietAt=nil
                    local maximum=tonumber(p:GetAttribute("BagSlotsMax")) or 120
                    if (tonumber(p:GetAttribute("BagSlotsUsed")) or 0)>=maximum then
                        s.LootTarget=nil
                        ctx.Status("Bag full while collecting boss loot; selling gear")
                        ctx.SellEquipment(token)
                        -- Return directly to the remaining boss loot after selling.
                        if list[1].Parent then ctx.MoveTo(list[1].Position+Vector3.new(0,4,0),token) end
                    else
                        local nextTarget=list[1]
                        if target~=nextTarget then target=nextTarget; progressAt=os.clock(); lastDistance=math.huge end
                        local point=target.Position
                        local delta=Vector3.new(point.X-current.Position.X,0,point.Z-current.Position.Z)
                        local distance=delta.Magnitude
                        s.LootTarget=Vector3.new(point.X,current.Position.Y,point.Z)
                        ctx.Status("Collecting boss loot: "..#list.." remaining")
                        if distance<lastDistance-1 then progressAt=os.clock(); lastDistance=distance end
                        if distance<7 and os.clock()>pickupAt then
                            -- Same nearby pickup request used by the game's normal loot controller.
                            ctx.Remotes.PickupDrop:FireServer(true)
                            pickupAt=os.clock()+0.8
                        end
                        if os.clock()-progressAt>3 then
                            s.LootTarget=nil
                            ctx.MoveTo(point+Vector3.new(0,4,0),token)
                            progressAt=os.clock()
                            lastDistance=math.huge
                        end
                    end
                end
                ctx.Sleep(0.15,token)
            end
            error("Boss loot remains uncollected; paused in the room",0)
        end)
        s.LootTarget=nil
        s.Looting=false
        local _,h=ctx.Character()
        if h then h:Move(Vector3.zero,false) end
        if not ok then error(err,0) end
    end
    s.CollectBossLoot=sweep
    s.RequestCollect=function(self,room)
        self.ForceCollect=room or self.Zone
        if not self.Active then self:Start() end
    end
    return sweep
end
]====],
    ["hunting-policy.lua"] = [====[local P={}
function P.Team(members,preferred)
    local floor,ready,leader=nil,true,nil
    for _,m in ipairs(members) do
        if not m.Present or type(m.Level)~="number" then ready=false end
        if type(m.Level)=="number" then floor=math.min(floor or m.Level,m.Level) end
        if m.Id==preferred and m.Job~="Cleric" then leader=m end
    end
    if not leader then
        for _,m in ipairs(members) do
            if m.Job~="Cleric" and (not leader or (m.Level or 0)>(leader.Level or 0)
                or ((m.Level or 0)==(leader.Level or 0) and m.Id<leader.Id)) then leader=m end
        end
    end
    if not leader then
        for _,m in ipairs(members) do if not leader or m.Id<leader.Id then leader=m end end
    end
    return {Level=floor or 1,Ready=ready,LeaderId=leader and leader.Id}
end
function P.Box(state,now)
    if not state.Enabled then return "off" end
    if not state.Leader then return "follower" end
    if not state.GroupReady then return "party_wait" end
    if state.Pending then return "await_result" end
    if state.Danger then return "fight_first" end
    if (state.LuckyUntil or 0)>now then return "lucky_hold" end
    return "ready"
end
return P
]====],
    ["hunting-team-box.lua"] = [====[return function(ctx,options,persist)
    local s,p,r=ctx.State,ctx.Player,ctx.Remotes
    local Players=game:GetService("Players")
    local Tags=game:GetService("CollectionService")
    local Policy=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-policy.lua")))()
    local nativeSetting=ctx.Json("SettingsJson").AutoOpenBox
    local cachedTeam,teamAt=nil,0
    local partySignature,partyChangedAt=nil,os.clock()
    local pending,encounter,boxError=nil,nil,nil
    local requestSent=false
    local inferredLuckyUntil=0
    s.BoxCancel=function()
        if pending and requestSent then boxError="Stopped before box result; check enemy before retry" end
        pending=nil; requestSent=false; s.BoxPending=false
    end
    local cacheSignature=nil
    local function rootOf(member)
        local c=member and member.Character
        local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        local root=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
        if h and root and h.Health>0 then return root end
    end
    local function team()
        if cachedTeam and os.clock()<teamAt then return cachedTeam end
        teamAt=os.clock()+0.4
        local party=ctx.Json("PartyJson")
        local entries=party.Members
        if type(entries)~="table" or #entries==0 then entries={{UserId=p.UserId}} end
        local members,lookup={},{}
        for _,entry in ipairs(entries) do
            local id=tonumber(entry.UserId)
            if id then
                local member=Players:GetPlayerByUserId(id)
                lookup[id]=member
                members[#members+1]={Id=id,Level=member and tonumber(member:GetAttribute("Level")),
                    Job=member and member:GetAttribute("Job"),Present=member~=nil,Player=member}
            end
        end
        local result=Policy.Team(members,tonumber(party.Leader))
        local ids={}
        for _,member in ipairs(members) do ids[#ids+1]=tostring(member.Id) end
        table.sort(ids)
        local signature=table.concat(ids,",").."|"..tostring(result.LeaderId)
        if signature~=partySignature then partySignature=signature; partyChangedAt=os.clock() end
        result.Members=members
        result.Leader=lookup[result.LeaderId]
        result.IsLeader=result.LeaderId==p.UserId
        result.Healer=#members>1 and p:GetAttribute("Job")=="Cleric"
        result.GroupReady=result.Ready and os.clock()-partyChangedAt>=2
        local leaderRoot=rootOf(result.Leader)
        for _,member in ipairs(members) do
            local root=rootOf(member.Player)
            if not leaderRoot or not root or (root.Position-leaderRoot.Position).Magnitude>90 then result.GroupReady=false end
        end
        cachedTeam=result
        s.Team={Level=result.Level,Ready=result.Ready,Count=#members,LeaderId=result.LeaderId,
            LeaderName=result.Leader and result.Leader.Name,Role=result.Healer and "Healer" or (result.IsLeader and "Main" or "Follow")}
        return result
    end
    s.GetTeamPlan=team
    s.GetFarmLevel=function() return team().Level end
    local function luckyUntil()
        local untilTime=inferredLuckyUntil
        for _,member in ipairs(team().Members) do
            if member.Player then
                local buffs=ctx.Decode(member.Player:GetAttribute("BuffsJson"))
                for _,buff in pairs(buffs) do
                    if buff.Id=="box_lucky" then untilTime=math.max(untilTime,tonumber(buff.EndsAt) or 0) end
                end
            end
        end
        return untilTime
    end
    s.LuckyUntil=luckyUntil
    local function boxStatus(text)
        if s.BoxStatus~=text then
            s.BoxEvents=s.BoxEvents or {}
            s.BoxEvents[#s.BoxEvents+1]={At=workspace:GetServerTimeNow(),State=text,Opened=s.BoxesOpened or 0}
            while #s.BoxEvents>50 do table.remove(s.BoxEvents,1) end
            pcall(function() writefile("hunting-box-history.json",ctx.Http:JSONEncode(s.BoxEvents)) end)
        end
        s.BoxStatus=text
    end
    local function nearDanger(point,radius,baseline)
        local folder=workspace:FindFirstChild("Monsters")
        for _,model in ipairs(folder and folder:GetChildren() or {}) do
            if model:IsA("Model") and model.PrimaryPart and (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0)>0
                and (not baseline or not baseline[model]) then
                local id=tostring(model:GetAttribute("MonsterId") or "")
                local danger=model:GetAttribute("IsMiniBoss")==true or model:GetAttribute("IsBoss")==true
                    or id:find("halloween_pumpkin",1,true) or model.Name:lower():find("spider",1,true)
                if danger and (model.PrimaryPart.Position-point).Magnitude<radius then return model end
            end
        end
    end
    table.insert(s.Connections,r.Notify.OnClientEvent:Connect(function(message)
        if pending then
            s.LastBoxNotice=tostring(message)
            pcall(function() writefile("hunting-box-notice.txt",s.LastBoxNotice) end)
        end
    end))
    local function tuneSupport(on)
        local settings=ctx.Json("BotJson")
        settings.Mode=on and "support" or "fight"
        settings.NormalAttack=not on
        settings.UseSkills=true
        settings.HealPercent=80
        settings.OpenBoxes=false
        settings.FixedArea=false
        settings.AttackLeader=true
        settings.SkipBoss=false
        settings.SkipLeader=false
        r.SetBotSettings:FireServer(settings)
    end
    s.PartyFollow=function(token)
        local plan=team()
        if plan.IsLeader or #plan.Members<=1 then return false end
        boxStatus("Follower: main character opens boxes")
        local ownRoot=rootOf(p)
        local leaderRoot=rootOf(plan.Leader)
        if not ownRoot or not leaderRoot then ctx.SetAuto(false); ctx.Status("Waiting for party leader"); return true end
        local bossRoom
        for id,z in pairs(ctx.Nav().Zones or {}) do
            if id:match("^Boss") and math.abs(leaderRoot.Position.X-z.X)<z.SX/2+5
                and math.abs(leaderRoot.Position.Z-z.Z)<z.SZ/2+5 then bossRoom=id; break end
        end
        s.BossActive=bossRoom and {Id="party_boss",Room=bossRoom} or nil
        if os.clock()<(s.DodgeUntil or 0) then ctx.SetAuto(false); return true end
        if (ownRoot.Position-leaderRoot.Position).Magnitude>28 then
            ctx.Status("Following "..plan.Leader.Name)
            local offset=leaderRoot.CFrame.LookVector*-9+leaderRoot.CFrame.RightVector*5
            if not ctx.MoveTo(leaderRoot.Position+offset,token) then return true end
        end
        local signature=tostring(plan.LeaderId).."|"..tostring(plan.Healer).."|"..tostring(s.Zone)
        if cacheSignature~=signature then tuneSupport(plan.Healer); cacheSignature=signature end
        if not plan.Healer then
            local target=plan.Leader:FindFirstChild("CurrentTarget")
            local ownTarget=p:FindFirstChild("CurrentTarget")
            if target and ownTarget and target.Value~=ownTarget.Value then ownTarget.Value=target.Value end
        end
        ctx.SetAuto(true)
        s.Zone=nil
        ctx.Status((plan.Healer and "Healing/following " or "Assisting ")..plan.Leader.Name.." | Team Lv."..plan.Level)
        return true
    end
    local function suppressNativeBoxes()
        if not options.SmartBoxes then return end
        local settings=ctx.Json("SettingsJson")
        if settings.AutoOpenBox~=false then
            settings.AutoOpenBox=false
            r.SetSettings:FireServer(settings)
        end
    end
    suppressNativeBoxes()
    local restore=s.CleanupExtra
    s.CleanupExtra=function()
        if restore then restore() end
        if nativeSetting~=nil then
            local settings=ctx.Json("SettingsJson"); settings.AutoOpenBox=nativeSetting
            pcall(function() r.SetSettings:FireServer(settings) end)
        end
    end
    local function fightEncounter(model,token)
        local id=tostring(model:GetAttribute("MonsterId") or "")
        local room=s.Zone
        if not room then return end
        s.BoxEncounter=id
        s.BossActive={Id=id,Room=room}
        local settings=ctx.Json("BotJson")
        settings.Mode="fight"; settings.FixedArea=false; settings.AttackLeader=true
        settings.SkipBoss=false; settings.SkipLeader=false; settings.OpenBoxes=false
        settings.Exclude=settings.Exclude or {}; settings.Exclude[id]=nil
        r.SetBotSettings:FireServer(settings)
        local started=os.clock()
        while model.Parent and model.PrimaryPart and (tonumber(model:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0)>0 do
            ctx.Check(token)
            local _,h=ctx.Character()
            if not h then return end
            boxStatus("Fight spawned enemy; boxes locked")
            if h.Health/h.MaxHealth<0.2 or os.clock()-started>180 then
                boxError="Spawned enemy remains: boxes locked"
                return
            end
            if os.clock()>=(s.DodgeUntil or 0) then
                ctx.SetAuto(true)
                local target=p:FindFirstChild("CurrentTarget")
                if target and target.Value~=model then target.Value=model end
            else ctx.SetAuto(false) end
            ctx.Sleep(0.2,token)
        end
        s.BoxEncounter=nil
        s.BossActive=nil
        s.Zone=nil
    end
    s.ShouldHuntBoss=function()
        return not pending and not encounter and not boxError and luckyUntil()<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() and team().GroupReady
    end
    s.BoxController=function(token)
        local plan=team()
        if not s.Zone or s.Looting then return end
        local _,_,root=ctx.Character()
        if not root then return end
        if encounter then
            if encounter.Parent and (tonumber(encounter:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0)>0 then fightEncounter(encounter,token) end
            if not encounter.Parent or (tonumber(encounter:GetAttribute("HP")) or 0)<=0 then encounter=nil; boxError=nil; s.BoxEncounter=nil; s.BossActive=nil end
            return
        end
        if boxError then boxStatus(boxError); return end
        local danger=nearDanger(root.Position,45)
        local untilTime=luckyUntil()
        s.LuckyRemaining=math.max(0,math.ceil(untilTime-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()))
        local decision=Policy.Box({Enabled=options.SmartBoxes,Leader=plan.IsLeader,GroupReady=plan.GroupReady,
            Pending=pending~=nil,Danger=danger~=nil,LuckyUntil=untilTime},workspace:GetServerTimeNow())
        if decision~="ready" then boxStatus(decision); return end
        suppressNativeBoxes()
        local selected,expires
        for _,box in ipairs(Tags:GetTagged("LootBox")) do
            if box:IsA("BasePart") and box.Parent and not box:GetAttribute("OpenTitle") then
                local owner=tonumber(box:GetAttribute("OwnerUserId")) or 0
                local allowed=owner==0 or owner==p.UserId or (tonumber(box:GetAttribute("FreeAt")) or 0)<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
                for _,member in ipairs(plan.Members) do if owner==member.Id then allowed=true end end
                local deadline=(tonumber(box:GetAttribute("SpawnedAt")) or workspace:GetServerTimeNow())+60
                if allowed and deadline-workspace:GetServerTimeNow()>4 and (box.Position-root.Position).Magnitude<65
                    and (not expires or deadline<expires) then selected,expires=box,deadline end
            end
        end
        if not selected then boxStatus("Waiting for a box"); return end
        local baseline={}
        for _,model in ipairs(workspace.Monsters:GetChildren()) do baseline[model]=true end
        local point=selected.Position
        local buffsBefore={}
        for _,buff in pairs(ctx.Json("BuffsJson")) do buffsBefore[buff.Id]=buff.EndsAt end
        pending=selected
        requestSent=false
        s.BoxPending=true
        boxStatus("Opening one box")
        if not ctx.MoveTo(point+Vector3.new(0,4,0),token) then
            pending=nil; s.BoxPending=false; s.Zone=nil
            return
        end
        if not selected.Parent then pending=nil; s.BoxPending=false; return end
        if nearDanger(point,50) or not team().GroupReady then
            pending=nil; s.BoxPending=false
            boxStatus("Wait: nearby enemy or party regrouping")
            return
        end
        -- Exactly one request. Unknown responses never cause an automatic retry.
        local prompt=selected:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt",true)
        s.LastBoxTrigger=prompt and "prompt" or "remote"
        requestSent=true
        if prompt then
            if type(fireproximityprompt)=="function" then
                fireproximityprompt(prompt)
            else
                prompt:InputHoldBegin()
                ctx.Sleep(math.max(0.1,prompt.HoldDuration+0.05),token)
                prompt:InputHoldEnd()
            end
        else
            r.OpenLootBox:FireServer(selected)
        end
        s.BoxesOpened=(s.BoxesOpened or 0)+1
        boxStatus("One request sent; waiting for result")
        local started=os.clock()
        local acknowledgedAt=nil
        while os.clock()-started<9 do
            ctx.Check(token)
            local spawned=nearDanger(point,90,baseline)
            if spawned then encounter=spawned; boxStatus("Spawn detected; no more boxes"); break end
            local acknowledged=not selected.Parent or selected:GetAttribute("OpenTitle")~=nil or luckyUntil()>workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
            local newBuff
            for _,buff in pairs(ctx.Json("BuffsJson")) do
                if tostring(buff.Id):match("^box_") and buff.EndsAt~=buffsBefore[buff.Id] then newBuff=buff.Id end
            end
            local title=tostring(selected:GetAttribute("OpenTitle") or ""):upper()
            if newBuff=="box_lucky" or title:find("LUCKY DROP",1,true) then
                if luckyUntil()<=workspace:GetServerTimeNow() then inferredLuckyUntil=workspace:GetServerTimeNow()+60 end
                boxStatus("Lucky Drop: keep buff until expiry")
            end
            acknowledged=acknowledged or newBuff~=nil
            if acknowledged then acknowledgedAt=acknowledgedAt or os.clock() end
            if acknowledgedAt and os.clock()-acknowledgedAt>(newBuff and 0.6 or 2.5) then break end
            ctx.Sleep(0.15,token)
        end
        pending=nil
        requestSent=false
        s.BoxPending=false
        if not acknowledgedAt and not encounter then boxError="Unknown box result; opening paused" end
        if encounter then fightEncounter(encounter,token) end
        s.Zone=nil -- Restore normal farm settings after the one-box transaction.
    end
    s.ResetBoxPause=function()
        if not pending and not encounter then boxError=nil end
    end
    s.Policy=Policy
end
]====],
    ["hunting-boss-plan.lua"] = [====[local B={}
local rooms={
    {Room="Boss01",Option="Gorilla",Label="Gorilla",HitBuffer=3,Timeout=240},
    {Room="Boss02",Option="Tiger",Label="Tiger",HitBuffer=3,Timeout=240},
    {Room="Boss03",Option="Pharaoh",Label="Pharaoh",HitBuffer=1.5,Timeout=420},
    {Room="Boss04",Option="Dragon",Label="Dragon",HitBuffer=1.5,Timeout=480},
    {Room="Boss05",Option="Turtle",Label="Lava Turtle",HitBuffer=1.5,Timeout=600},
}
function B.Build(map,monsters)
    local result={}
    for _,entry in ipairs(rooms) do
        local data=map[entry.Room]
        local id=data and data.Boss
        if id and monsters[id] then
            local item=table.clone(entry)
            item.Id=id
            result[#result+1]=item
        end
    end
    return result
end
function B.RequiredLevel(definition,cap)
    return math.min(cap or 99,(tonumber(definition.Level) or 99)+5)
end
function B.Readiness(entry,definition,stats,cap)
    local minimum=B.RequiredLevel(definition,cap)
    if (stats.Level or 1)<minimum then return false,"Lv."..minimum,minimum end
    local peak=0
    local function inspect(skill,depth)
        if type(skill)~="table" or depth>8 then return end
        local defense=skill.Magic and (stats.MDEF or 0) or (stats.DEF or 0)
        local damage=(definition.ATK or 0)*(tonumber(skill.Power) or 1)*1.2/(1+math.max(0,defense)/300)
        peak=math.max(peak,damage)
        inspect(skill.Then,depth+1)
    end
    for _,skill in pairs(definition.Skills or {}) do inspect(skill,0) end
    if peak==0 then peak=(definition.ATK or 0)*2.8*1.2/(1+math.max(0,stats.DEF or 0)/300) end
    local buffer=entry.HitBuffer or 3
    if buffer<3 and stats.HasHealer then buffer=math.max(1.15,buffer*0.8) end
    local needed=math.ceil(peak*buffer)
    if (stats.MaxHP or 0)<needed then return false,"HP "..needed,minimum,needed end
    return true,"ready",minimum,needed
end
return B
]====],
    ["hunting-settings.lua"] = [====[local S={}
S.Defaults={Bosses=false,Gorilla=true,Tiger=true,Pharaoh=true,Dragon=true,Turtle=true,
    AutoStats=false,Primary="DEX",AutoBoost=false,Dodge=true,SmartBoxes=true,
    ResumeOnLoad=true,LastRunning=true,Collapsed=false,Tab="Farm",UIX=0.025,UIY=0.08,
    FarmRadius=40,FarmLayoutVersion=1,SellAtPercent=95,RestoreGameSkill=false,GameAutoSkill=false}
function S.Normalize(data)
    local result=table.clone(S.Defaults)
    if type(data)~="table" then return result end
    for key,value in pairs(result) do
        if type(value)=="boolean" and type(data[key])=="boolean" then result[key]=data[key] end
    end
    if table.find({"STR","AGI","VIT","INT","DEX","LUK"},data.Primary) then result.Primary=data.Primary end
    if table.find({"Farm","Boss","Character","Team"},data.Tab) then result.Tab=data.Tab end
    for key,limits in pairs({UIX={0,0.95},UIY={0,0.95},FarmRadius={20,150},SellAtPercent={50,100}}) do
        local value=data[key]
        if type(value)=="number" and value==value and math.abs(value)<math.huge then result[key]=math.clamp(value,limits[1],limits[2]) end
    end
    return result
end
function S.Open(id,http)
    local path="hunting-helper-settings-"..tostring(id)..".json"
    local function read(pathToRead)
        if type(isfile)~="function" or not isfile(pathToRead) then return nil end
        local ok,data=pcall(function() return http:JSONDecode(readfile(pathToRead)) end)
        return ok and type(data)=="table" and data or nil
    end
    local raw=read(path)
    if not raw then
        local ownerPath="hunting-helper-settings-owner.txt"
        local owner=nil
        if type(isfile)=="function" and isfile(ownerPath) then
            local ok,value=pcall(readfile,ownerPath)
            if ok then owner=tonumber(value) end
        end
        if owner==nil or owner==id then
            raw=read("hunting-helper-options.json")
            if raw then pcall(writefile,ownerPath,tostring(id)) end
        end
    end
    if raw and raw.FarmLayoutVersion~=1 then
        raw=table.clone(raw)
        raw.FarmRadius=40
    end
    local settings=S.Normalize(raw)
    local function save(values)
        local normalized=S.Normalize(values)
        normalized.UserId=id
        local ok,err=pcall(function() writefile(path,http:JSONEncode(normalized)) end)
        return ok,err
    end
    save(settings)
    return settings,save,path,function() return read(path) end
end
return S
]====],
    ["hunting-ui.lua"] = [====[return function(s,p)
    local UIS=game:GetService("UserInputService")
    local ui={Checks={},Choices={},Dynamic={},Pages={},Tabs={}}
    local C={Bg=Color3.fromRGB(15,22,32),Panel=Color3.fromRGB(24,34,48),Row=Color3.fromRGB(30,43,58),
        Border=Color3.fromRGB(48,64,81),Text=Color3.fromRGB(235,242,248),Muted=Color3.fromRGB(151,169,185),
        Accent=Color3.fromRGB(70,219,181),Dark=Color3.fromRGB(9,37,31),Orange=Color3.fromRGB(245,190,105)}
    local function make(class,props,parent)
        local n=Instance.new(class)
        for _,attribute in ipairs({"LumiKeepColor","LumiKeepFont","LumiNoPixelFont","LumiNoTranslate","LumiNoLine"}) do n:SetAttribute(attribute,true) end
        for key,value in pairs(props or {}) do n[key]=value end
        n.Parent=parent
        return n
    end
    local function corner(n,r) make("UICorner",{CornerRadius=UDim.new(0,r or 9)},n) end
    local function text(parent,value,x,y,w,h,size,color)
        return make("TextLabel",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Text=value,Font=Enum.Font.Gotham,
            TextSize=size or 14,TextColor3=color or C.Text,TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
            TextWrapped=true,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)},parent)
    end
    local function button(parent,value,x,y,w,h,callback,accent)
        local b=make("TextButton",{Text=value,Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold,TextSize=13,
            TextColor3=accent and C.Dark or C.Text,BackgroundColor3=accent and C.Accent or C.Row,
            BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(x,y),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(w,h)},parent)
        corner(b,8); b.Activated:Connect(callback)
        return b
    end
    local gui=make("ScreenGui",{Name="HuntingHelper",ResetOnSpawn=false,IgnoreGuiInset=true,DisplayOrder=1000},p:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))
    local panel=make("Frame",{Name="Window",Size=UDim2.fromOffset(500,450),
        Position=UDim2.fromScale(s.Options.UIX,s.Options.UIY),BackgroundColor3=C.Bg,BorderSizePixel=0,
        Active=true,ClipsDescendants=true},gui)
    corner(panel,12)
    local windowScale=make("UIScale",{Scale=1},panel)
    make("UIStroke",{Color=C.Border,Thickness=1},panel)
    local header=make("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=C.Panel,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.new(1,0,0,48),Active=true},panel)
    local logo=button(header,"H",12,10,28,28,function() if s.Active then s:Stop() else s:Start() end end,true)
    local title=text(header,"HUNTING HELPER",50,8,320,20,15)
    title.Font=Enum.Font.GothamBold
    local sub=text(header,"FARM  /  PARTY  /  BOSSES",50,28,320,12,9,C.Muted)
    local minimize=button(header,"—",426,10,28,28,function() s:SetOption("Collapsed",not s.Options.Collapsed); ui:Refresh() end)
    minimize.Name="Collapse"
    local close=button(header,"×",462,10,26,28,function() s:Stop(); s:Destroy() end)
    local content=make("Frame",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(0,48),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(500,402)},panel)
    local tabBar=make("Frame",{BackgroundTransparency=1,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,6),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(476,34)},content)
    for i,entry in ipairs({{"Farm","ฟาร์ม"},{"Boss","บอส"},{"Character","ตัวละคร"},{"Team","ปาร์ตี้"}}) do
        local key=entry[1]
        ui.Tabs[key]=button(tabBar,entry[2],(i-1)*120,0,116,32,function() s:SetOption("Tab",key); ui:Refresh() end)
    end
    local summary=text(content,"",16,46,468,22,13,C.Accent)
    local status=text(content,"",16,69,468,30,12,C.Muted)
    local function page(key)
        local sc=make("ScrollingFrame",{Name=key,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,106),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(476,230),
            BackgroundTransparency=1,BorderSizePixel=0,ScrollBarThickness=3,ScrollBarImageColor3=C.Border,
            CanvasSize=UDim2.new(),AutomaticCanvasSize=Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,Visible=false},content)
        make("UIListLayout",{Padding=UDim.new(0,7),SortOrder=Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder},sc)
        make("UIPadding",{PaddingBottom=UDim.new(0,8),PaddingRight=UDim.new(0,6)},sc)
        ui.Pages[key]=sc
        return sc
    end
    local function card(parent,height)
        local n=make("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=C.Panel,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.new(1,-3,0,height)},parent)
        corner(n,9)
        return n
    end
    local function checkbox(parent,label,detail,get,set)
        local row=make("TextButton",{Text="",BackgroundColor3=C.Panel,BorderSizePixel=0,Size=UDim2.new(1,-3,0,detail and 56 or 43)},parent)
        corner(row,9)
        local box=make("Frame",{BackgroundColor3=C.Row,BorderSizePixel=0,Position=UDim2.fromOffset(12,12),Size=UDim2.fromOffset(21,21)},row)
        corner(box,5)
        local tick=text(box,"✓",0,0,21,21,16,C.Dark); tick.TextXAlignment=Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
        local name=text(row,label,45,detail and 7 or 9,405,24,14)
        local description=detail and text(row,detail,45,31,405,17,11,C.Muted) or nil
        row.Activated:Connect(function() set(not get()); ui:Refresh() end)
        ui.Checks[#ui.Checks+1]={Get=get,Box=box,Tick=tick,Name=name,Detail=description}
        return row
    end
    local function optionCheck(parent,key,label,detail)
        return checkbox(parent,label,detail,function() return s.Options[key] end,function(on) s:SetOption(key,on) end)
    end
    local function selectRow(parent,key,label,values,display)
        local n=card(parent,72)
        text(n,label,12,7,440,22,13,C.Muted)
        local width=math.floor(440/#values)-5
        for i,value in ipairs(values) do
            local b=button(n,display and display(value) or tostring(value),12+(i-1)*(width+5),34,width,28,
                function() s:SetOption(key,value); ui:Refresh() end)

        end

        if dragging and (input==dragInput or input.UserInputType==Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            local delta=input.Position-inputStart
            if delta.Magnitude>4 then moved=true end
            local scale=panel.AbsoluteSize.X/(s.Options.Collapsed and 230 or 500)
            panel.Position=UDim2.new(panelStart.X.Scale,panelStart.X.Offset+delta.X/math.max(scale,0.1),panelStart.Y.Scale,panelStart.Y.Offset+delta.Y/math.max(scale,0.1))
        end
