    table.insert(s.Connections,UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input==dragInput then
            dragging=false
            if moved and workspace.CurrentCamera then
                local viewport=workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
                s:SetOption("UIX",math.clamp(panel.AbsolutePosition.X/viewport.X,0,0.85))
                s:SetOption("UIY",math.clamp(panel.AbsolutePosition.Y/viewport.Y,0,0.85))
            end
        end
    end))
    function ui:SetCollapsed(value) s:SetOption("Collapsed",value); self:Refresh() end
    function ui:Destroy() gui:Destroy() end
    ui.Gui,ui.Panel,ui.Content=gui,panel,content
    ui:Refresh()
    task.spawn(function() while not s.Destroyed do ui:Refresh(); task.wait(0.35) end end)
    return ui
end
]====],
    ["hunting-farm-plan.lua"] = [====[local P={}
local function distance2(a,b) return (a.X-b.X)^2+(a.Z-b.Z)^2 end
local function finite(v) return type(v)=="number" and v==v and math.abs(v)<math.huge end
function P.LeaderFallback(zone)
    -- Both inspected fields use this right-hand leader corner; unvisited fields
    -- use its proportional offset until an idle leader is actually visible.
    return {X=zone.X+zone.SX*82/192,Z=zone.Z-zone.SZ*41/166}
end
function P.Valid(zone,point,radius,aggro)
    if type(point)~="table" or not finite(point.X) or not finite(point.Z)
        or not finite(point.LeaderX) or not finite(point.LeaderZ) then return false end
    return point.Radius==radius and point.X>zone.X
        and math.abs(point.X-zone.X)<=zone.SX/2-4 and math.abs(point.Z-zone.Z)<=zone.SZ/2-4
        and distance2(point,{X=point.LeaderX,Z=point.LeaderZ})<=(math.min(radius-3,aggro-2)+0.01)^2
end
function P.Choose(zone,leader,points,radius,aggro)
    local reach=math.max(1,math.min(radius-3,aggro-2))
    local minimum=reach*0.78
    local x0=zone.X+math.min(12,zone.SX/8)
    local x1=zone.X+zone.SX/2-8
    local z0,z1=zone.Z-zone.SZ/2+8,zone.Z+zone.SZ/2-8
    local preferred={X=math.clamp(leader.X-reach*0.8,x0,x1),Z=math.clamp(leader.Z+reach*0.6,z0,z1)}
    local best,bestCost,bestEdge
    local function consider(x,z,allowInner)
        if x<x0 or x>x1 or z<z0 or z>z1 then return end
        local point={X=x,Z=z}
        local leaderDistance=math.sqrt(distance2(point,leader))
        if leaderDistance>reach+0.001 or (not allowInner and leaderDistance<minimum) then return end
        local count,cost=0,0
        for _,mob in ipairs(points) do
            local d2=distance2(point,mob)
            if d2<=(radius-2)^2 then count+=1; cost+=d2 end
        end
        if count==0 then cost=distance2(point,preferred) end
        local edge=math.abs(reach-leaderDistance)
        if not best or count>best.Count or (count==best.Count and (cost<bestCost-0.001
            or (math.abs(cost-bestCost)<0.001 and edge<bestEdge))) then
            best={X=x,Z=z,Count=count,Radius=radius,LeaderX=leader.X,LeaderZ=leader.Z,LeaderDistance=leaderDistance}
            bestCost,bestEdge=cost,edge
        end
    end
    consider(preferred.X,preferred.Z)
    for x=math.ceil(math.max(x0,leader.X-reach)),math.floor(math.min(x1,leader.X+reach)) do
        for z=math.ceil(math.max(z0,leader.Z-reach)),math.floor(math.min(z1,leader.Z+reach)) do consider(x,z) end
    end
    if not best then consider(math.clamp(leader.X,x0,x1),math.clamp(leader.Z,z0,z1),true) end
    assert(best,"No right-side farm point inside leader aggro range")
    return best
end
return P
]====],
    ["hunting-travel-plan.lua"] = [====[local P={Clearance=55,MinWalk=8}
local function distance(a,b) return math.sqrt((a.X-b.X)^2+(a.Z-b.Z)^2) end
function P.Outsiders(players,party,selfId,origin)
    local result={}
    for _,p in ipairs(players) do
        if p.Id~=selfId and not party[p.Id] and p.Alive and p.Position
            and math.abs(p.Position.Y-origin.Y)<20 then result[#result+1]=p.Position end
    end
    return result
end
function P.Nearest(point,others)
    local nearest=math.huge
    for _,other in ipairs(others) do nearest=math.min(nearest,distance(point,other)) end
    return nearest
end
function P.ShouldWalk(origin,destination,others)
    return distance(origin,destination)>12 and P.Nearest(origin,others)<P.Clearance
end
function P.Choices(origin,destination,others,bounds)
    local preferred=destination.Z<origin.Z and -1 or 1
    local result,seen={},{}
    local initial=P.Nearest(origin,others)
    for _,direction in ipairs({preferred,-preferred}) do
        for _,step in ipairs({24,48,72}) do
            for _,lane in ipairs({0,origin.X>0 and -16 or 16}) do
                local x,z=origin.X+lane,origin.Z+direction*step
                if bounds then
                    x=math.clamp(x,bounds.X-bounds.SX/2+8,bounds.X+bounds.SX/2-8)
                    z=math.clamp(z,bounds.Z-bounds.SZ/2+8,bounds.Z+bounds.SZ/2-8)
                end
                local point={X=x,Z=z}
                local length=distance(point,origin)
                local key=string.format("%.1f:%.1f",x,z)
                if length>=P.MinWalk and not seen[key] then
                    seen[key]=true
                    local nearest=P.Nearest(point,others)
                    local minimum=math.huge
                    local dx,dz=x-origin.X,z-origin.Z
                    for _,other in ipairs(others) do
                        local t=math.clamp(((other.X-origin.X)*dx+(other.Z-origin.Z)*dz)/(length*length),0,1)
                        minimum=math.min(minimum,distance({X=origin.X+t*dx,Z=origin.Z+t*dz},other))
                    end
                    point.Direction=direction
                    point.Nearest=nearest
                    point.Score=(nearest>=P.Clearance and 1000+math.min(nearest-P.Clearance,20)*0.1 or nearest)
                        +(direction==preferred and 6 or 0)-length*0.25-(minimum<initial-4 and 5000 or 0)
                    result[#result+1]=point
                end
            end
        end
    end
    table.sort(result,function(a,b) return a.Score>b.Score end)
    return result
end
return P
]====],
    ["hunting-travel-walk.lua"] = [====[return function(ctx)
    local s,p=ctx.State,ctx.Player
    local Players=game:GetService("Players")
    local Pathfinder=game:GetService("PathfindingService")
    local P=assert(loadstring(readfile("hunting-travel-plan.lua")))()
    local function position(v) return {X=v.X,Y=v.Y,Z=v.Z} end
    local function outsiders(origin)
        local party={[p.UserId]=true}
        for _,entry in ipairs(ctx.Json("PartyJson").Members or {}) do
            local id=tonumber(entry.UserId)
            if id then party[id]=true end
        end
        local players={}
        for _,member in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            local c=member.Character
            local root=c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
            local h=c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
            if root and h then players[#players+1]={Id=member.UserId,Alive=h.Health>0,Position=position(root.Position)} end
        end
        return P.Outsiders(players,party,p.UserId,origin)
    end
    local function boundsFor(root)
        for _,zone in pairs(ctx.Nav().Zones or {}) do
            if math.abs(root.Position.X-zone.X)<zone.SX/2 and math.abs(root.Position.Z-zone.Z)<zone.SZ/2
                and math.abs(root.Position.Y-zone.Y)<35 then return zone end
        end
    end
    s.CancelTravelWalk=function()
        local _,h,root=ctx.Character()
        if h and root then h:MoveTo(root.Position); h:Move(Vector3.zero,false) end
        if s.TravelWalk and s.TravelWalk.Phase=="walking" then s.TravelWalk.Phase="cancelled" end
    end
    local function walkRoute(candidate,token,start,deadline)
        local _,h,root=ctx.Character()
        if not root then return false end
        local path=Pathfinder:CreatePath({AgentRadius=2.5,AgentHeight=5,AgentCanJump=true,WaypointSpacing=6})
        local computed=pcall(function() path:ComputeAsync(root.Position,Vector3.new(candidate.X,root.Position.Y,candidate.Z)) end)
        ctx.Check(token)
        if not computed or path.Status~=Enum.PathStatus.Success then return false end
        for _,waypoint in ipairs(path:GetWaypoints()) do
            ctx.Check(token)
            local _,currentHumanoid,current=ctx.Character()
            if not current or os.clock()>deadline then return false end
            if waypoint.Action==Enum.PathWaypointAction.Jump then currentHumanoid.Jump=true end
            currentHumanoid:MoveTo(waypoint.Position)
            local waypointDeadline=math.min(deadline,os.clock()+2.5)
            local bestDistance=(current.Position-waypoint.Position).Magnitude
            local progressAt=os.clock()
            while os.clock()<waypointDeadline do
                ctx.Check(token)
                local _,_,now=ctx.Character()
                if not now then return false end
                if os.clock()<(s.DodgeUntil or 0) then
                    currentHumanoid:MoveTo(now.Position)
                    return false
                end
                local location=position(now.Position)
                local nearest=P.Nearest(location,outsiders(location))
                local walked=math.sqrt((location.X-start.X)^2+(location.Z-start.Z)^2)
                s.TravelWalk.Nearest=nearest<math.huge and nearest or nil
                s.TravelWalk.Walked=walked
                if nearest>=P.Clearance and walked>=P.MinWalk then return true end
                local remaining=(now.Position-waypoint.Position).Magnitude
                if remaining<3 then break end
                if remaining<bestDistance-0.5 then bestDistance=remaining; progressAt=os.clock() end
                if os.clock()-progressAt>1.4 then return false end
                ctx.Sleep(0.15,token)
            end
        end
        return false
    end
    local function beforeWarp(destination,token)
        local _,h,root=ctx.Character()
        if not root then return false end
        local start=position(root.Position)
        local others=outsiders(start)
        if not P.ShouldWalk(start,position(destination),others) then
            s.TravelWalk={Phase="clear",Walked=0,Nearest=P.Nearest(start,others)<math.huge and P.Nearest(start,others) or nil}
            return true
        end
        s.TravelWalk={Phase="walking",Walked=0,Required=P.Clearance}
        local clearAt=nil
        while true do
            ctx.Check(token)
            local _,currentHumanoid,current=ctx.Character()
            if not current then s.TravelWalk.Phase="respawn"; return false end
            local location=position(current.Position)
            others=outsiders(location)
            local nearest=P.Nearest(location,others)
            local walked=math.sqrt((location.X-start.X)^2+(location.Z-start.Z)^2)
            s.TravelWalk.Nearest=nearest<math.huge and nearest or nil
            s.TravelWalk.Walked=walked
            if os.clock()<(s.DodgeUntil or 0) then
                currentHumanoid:MoveTo(current.Position)
                ctx.Sleep(0.15,token)
            elseif nearest>=P.Clearance and walked>=P.MinWalk then
                currentHumanoid:MoveTo(current.Position)
                clearAt=clearAt or os.clock()
                if os.clock()-clearAt>=0.5 then s.TravelWalk.Phase="clear"; return true end
                ctx.Sleep(0.15,token)
            else
                clearAt=nil
                local choices=P.Choices(location,position(destination),others,boundsFor(current))
                local cleared=false
                for i=1,math.min(3,#choices) do
                    ctx.Check(token)
                    local candidate=choices[i]
                    s.TravelWalk.Direction=candidate.Direction==-1 and "next zone" or "previous zone"
                    ctx.Status("Walking toward "..s.TravelWalk.Direction.." before travel")
                    if walkRoute(candidate,token,start,os.clock()+7) then cleared=true; break end
                end
                if not cleared then
                    s.CancelTravelWalk()
                    s.TravelWalk.Phase="walking"
                    ctx.Status("Waiting for space before travel")
                    ctx.Sleep(1,token)
                end
            end
        end
    end
    s.PreviewTravelWalk=function(destination)
        local _,_,root=ctx.Character()
        if not root then return nil end
        local start=position(root.Position)
        local others=outsiders(start)
        return {Needed=P.ShouldWalk(start,position(destination),others),Nearest=P.Nearest(start,others)<math.huge and P.Nearest(start,others) or nil,
            Clearance=P.Clearance,Choices=P.Choices(start,position(destination),others,boundsFor(root))}
    end
    return beforeWarp
end
]====]
}
local nativeLoadstring, nativeReadfile = loadstring, readfile
local environment = setmetatable({}, {__index = getfenv(0)})
environment.readfile = function(name)
    if sources[name] then return sources[name] end
    assert(type(nativeReadfile) == "function", "Local file reading is unavailable")
    return nativeReadfile(name)
end
environment.loadstring = function(source, name)
    local fn, err = nativeLoadstring(source, name)
    if fn then setfenv(fn, environment) end
    return fn, err
end
local start, err = environment.loadstring(sources["scp.lua"], "@HuntingHelper")
assert(start, err)
return start()
